title: The Kybalion
subtitle: A study of Hermetic philosophy
author: Three Initiates
description: An influential exploration of seven principles associated with Hermetic philosophy. Read as a modern esoteric interpretation.
editionNote: First published in 1908. This is a modern esoteric work, not an ancient Hermetic source. Its historical claims should be considered critically. PDF is a reflowed reading edition.
